name: Laya PII Guard
description: Checks Excel, Word, CSV or pasted text for personal data - names, PPS numbers, dates of birth, contact details, Eircodes, bank and card numbers, member/policy numbers and health details - and removes it. Get a clean copy safe for any AI tool (with a private key to put real values back), an anonymised copy for sharing, or an answer about your data without exposing anyone.

conversation_starters.title: Does this have PII?
conversation_starters.text: Check this file for personal data.

conversation_starters.title: Make a clean copy
conversation_starters.text: Remove the personal data from this file so I can use it with AI, but let me put the real values back later.

conversation_starters.title: Anonymise to share
conversation_starters.text: Make an anonymised copy of this file that I can share.

conversation_starters.title: Answer safely
conversation_starters.text: Answer this question about my data without exposing anyone's details:

conversation_starters.title: Put real values back
conversation_starters.text: Here's my cleaned file and its key - please put the real values back.
